name: Vigilant Palm
description: Strike with a palm that has marked the foe's last three openings and chooses the best of them.

name: Vigilant Hold
description: Hold the stance the order's records show has never failed under this kind of pressure.

name: Vigilant Count
description: Keep a ceaseless count of every person and movement near the line.

name: Vigilant Cue
description: Give the order's cue so that the whole rank falls into the drilled response at the same instant.

name: Vigilant Mending
description: Mend the half-forgotten hours of a comrade struck on the head with the order's clear record of them.

name: Vigilant Haze
description: Spread a haze over the foe's memory of the line's strength so the foe misjudges what is before it.

name: Vigilant Lance
description: Send a lance of the order's long memory through the guard of the foe's mind.

name: Vigilant Ward
description: Hold the order's collected memory firm so that no false picture can settle in the line.

name: Vigilant Mirror
description: Hold a mirror of the order's memory before the line so a probing technique is turned back on its caster.

name: Vigilant Memory
description: The order's closing move that shares one flawless memory of the fight among the whole company at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Cobalt Fist
description: Throw a cold dark fist that follows the line of the best blow in the school's record.

name: Cobalt Screen
description: Draw a deep blue screen of recollection round the body that dulls the force of a hit.

name: Cobalt Count
description: Count the exits and the watchers of a place and set the count in an unbroken line.

name: Cobalt Tread
description: Tread a line the mind already walked and arrive without a mistake.

name: Cobalt Prompt
description: Prompt an ally with the school's cue and see the ally's whole drill rise at once.

name: Cobalt Mending
description: Mend a mind scoured by a probe with a clean copy of its own recent days.

name: Cobalt Blur
description: Blur the foe's picture of the user's side to a smear of blue.

name: Cobalt Replay
description: Replay the last moments of a scene at half speed to find the hand that moved first.

name: Cobalt Spear
description: Hurl a spear of a foe's own forgotten history through its guard of mind.

name: Cobalt Ward
description: Hold a deep-blue ward that no rewriting touch can pass.

name: Cobalt Unmaking
description: Unmake from the foe a chosen year of memory with no wound on the body.

name: Cobalt Recollection
description: The school's closing move that cuts a recollection into the foe's mind and seals the foe's own away at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Apex Palm
description: Strike with a palm that carries the whole summed memory of the user's bouts.

name: Apex Cover
description: Throw over the body the best cover that the Core has ever recalled.

name: Apex Sense
description: Sense every item in the scene as if all of it had been catalogued the day before.

name: Apex Cue
description: Give a cue from the height of the Core and see the ally's whole body obey it.

name: Apex Mending
description: Mend years of lost memory in an ally by pouring in the user's exact record of them.

name: Apex Veil
description: Draw a veil of overlapping years over the foe's mind so the foe cannot place the present.

name: Apex Breaker
description: Break a probing technique in the middle of its reach with a flood of the user's own memory.

name: Apex Lance
description: Hurl a lance of Core-height memory through the foe's guard of mind.

name: Apex Ward
description: Hold a ward at the apex of the Core that no tampering can climb.

name: Apex Mirror
description: Hold up a mirror of the user's whole remembered life and turn a probe back on the prober.

name: Apex Memory
description: The discipline's closing move that lets the summed past fall on the field and lifts the allies on it at a depth set by the user's reserve.

name: Leeward Palm
description: Strike from the sheltered side of a remembered gust with a palm the wind cannot turn.

name: Leeward Hold
description: Hold a sheltered stance that remembers where each gust blew from.

name: Leeward Count
description: Count the moves of the wind of the fight and note which of them has not yet been used.

name: Leeward Cue
description: Call a cue that blows through the company and sets every comrade in the drill.

name: Leeward Mending
description: Mend a comrade whose memory has been scattered by a sudden blow by sorting the scattered parts back in order.

name: Leeward Haze
description: Raise a haze of stirred memories to cover the company's passage from the foe's recollection.

name: Leeward Lance
description: Throw a lance of remembered wind through the foe's guard of mind from the side the foe is not watching.

name: Leeward Ward
description: Hold the lee of a remembered storm round the company so false pictures cannot blow in.

name: Leeward Mirror
description: Turn a probing gale of memory back on the one who raised it with a mirror of still air.

name: Leeward Memory
description: The school's closing move that shelters the company's memory in a calm lee while confusion blows round the foe at a strength set by the user's reserve.

name: Stormkept Fist
description: Throw a fist with the full memory of a storm's weight behind it.

name: Stormkept Cover
description: Pull a cover of remembered storm round the body to scatter the first hit.

name: Stormkept Sense
description: Read the weather of a fight by the memory of storms of its kind.

name: Stormkept Cue
description: Cry the storm cue that brings the company's drilled response up at once.

name: Stormkept Mending
description: Mend a mind battered by a storm of images with the calm record of the user.

name: Stormkept Haze
description: Stir a storm of true and false memories round the foe until the foe cannot sort them.

name: Stormkept Replay
description: Replay a storm of events in slow order to find the first drop.

name: Stormkept Lance
description: Hurl a lance of stormed memory through the guard of the foe's mind.

name: Stormkept Ward
description: Hold a ward of storm-hardened memory that no false picture can cross.

name: Stormkept Unmaking
description: Blow a chain of the foe's memory away in a gale and strike at the gap it leaves.

name: Stormkept Memory
description: The school's closing move that loosens the whole kept storm of memory into the foe's mind at a force set by the user's reserve.

name: Covenant Fist
description: Strike with a fist that remembers the terms of a covenant and the price of breaking it.

name: Covenant Cover
description: Cover a covenant-mate with the user's guard and the memory of the covenant.

name: Covenant Count
description: Count the covenant-mates present and note who has strayed from their term.

name: Covenant Tread
description: Tread the covenant's rehearsed paces so a company moves as one body.

name: Covenant Prompt
description: Prompt a covenant-mate with the covenant's words and see the mate's stance firm.

name: Covenant Mending
description: Mend the strain a broken covenant did to a mate's memory by restoring the true terms.

name: Covenant Haze
description: Cloud a foe's memory of the covenant's secret passwords and posts.

name: Covenant Replay
description: Replay the swearing of a covenant to see who truly gave their word.

name: Covenant Spear
description: Hurl a spear of the covenant's memory at a breaker of it through the guard of the mind.

name: Covenant Ward
description: Hold the covenant's memory so firmly that no one can make the mates forget it.

name: Covenant Erasure
description: Erase from a covenant-breaker the memory of the covenant so the breaker's claim to its protection is gone.

name: Covenant Memory
description: The discipline's closing move that seals the covenant-breaker's recall and lifts every mate who keeps it at a depth set by the user's reserve.
